literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports RTN4RL2 cDNA cloned into the pDisplay vector for cell-surface binding assays. This does not constitute an epitope-tag insertion into RTN4RL2: RTN4RL2 is the insert, not the recipient of a tag; no epitope tag (FLAG, HA, Myc, ALFA, etc.) is placed at any specific residue of RTN4RL2; pDisplay is a commercial vector and the junction position within RTN4RL2 is unstated, making insert_after_residue impossible to pin; and the construct is used for ligand-binding assays, not tag-position validation. The commercial-plasmid exclusion rule therefore applies. RTN4RL2's canonical topology (signal peptide 1–46, extracellular 47–420, no TM domain) means the entire mature protein is extracellular, but that structural inference cannot substitute for a qualifying ledger line. Zero sites are reported.
